title: Chapter 375
text:
Hu!

Blue flames shot out from the bottom of the equipment box and flew over. The accessories assembled automatically, and the Amphiptere switched to flight mode.

"Location reported." Han Xiao quickly equipped himself and grabbed Aroshia to fly into the sky. He was not worried that Aroshia would be injured in the high-speed flight. She had Super Power in her body, and even if she did not use it, her resistance would still protect her.

Han Xiao sent the coordinates over, and the tactical screen displayed a three-dimensional map with Herlous' aircraft marked. The speed of the turbine in Han Xiao's wings soared, and the exhaust flames shot out. He directly went from stationary to high-speed flight without any buffer period. The mechanical suit could eliminate most of the load, and Han Xiao could handle the rest of the load.

Aroshia was held in front of Han Xiao's chest. Her hair danced in the wind, and her eyes were closed. She was not injured.

After Han Xiao reverse-engineered the Dragonfly, he modified the bat wings and added anti-gravity propulsion technology, and its speed soared.

While flying, Han Xiao thought about the other party's identity. Ashes' Carbon Control reminded him of a super Esper Ability that existed in theory — Particle Manipulation. It far exceeded the limit of a single element's ability and was almost omnipotent. It could form and deconstruct any matter. If the energy was strong enough, it could theoretically manipulate planets to split, recombine, or even form life. If it was more powerful, it could directly change the structure of particles and form antimatter out of thin air. It could also complete particle collisions without any machinery, simulate all kinds of physical phenomena, or even perform ultra-dense compression to form black holes with bare hands!

This type of Esper Ability that touched the origin of matter was too terrifying. It was like the omnipotent Creator. It was listed in the 'Super High Risk Esper Ability Restriction Treaty' by the three universes. There were hundreds of Super High Risk Esper Abilities that theoretically could exist in it.

However, the pursuit of individuals always conflicted with the collective. The Super High Risk Esper Abilities in the treaty were ranked by busybodies and became a list of 'Most Wanted Esper Abilities'. Fortunately, most of the Super High Risk Esper Abilities never appeared.

The ability to control particles had always been ranked in the top five. There were no eyewitness reports. It was rumored that it could not be awakened by itself and had to be fused into a shape. Another rumor was that this ability was a "living thing" with consciousness. It was some kind of energy field type life form that manifested as a self-flowing grand energy that wandered in the vast universe. It was said that there had once been a host of this ability, but it could not withstand the enormous energy and the host's genes collapsed and died. However, there were no eyewitness reports, so no one knew whether it was true or not. After all, there were all kinds of rumors in the universe. There were even rumors in the Shattered Star Ring that Dragon Emperor Ames was actually a man. (

Although carbon manipulation was a far cry from particle manipulation, there were similarities between the two. It was iconic and unique, and the name [Ashes] revealed in the battle information was a little familiar to him.

Han Xiao racked his brains. Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration and a memory emerged from the water.

"His codename is Ashes … and his ability is to manipulate carbon … Dark-star's strongest combatant!?"

Han Xiao was shocked and surprised.

Ashes did not know that the information he had revealed in the battle earlier was enough for Han Xiao to guess his identity. Ashes originally wanted to keep it a secret, but he had already failed in front of Han Xiao.

The reason he was able to confirm his target was because the codename 'Ashes' and his ability were too iconic for the same person. In his previous life, with the Mutation Disaster as the boundary, the battle between Dark-star and Godora gradually turned from a hidden one to an open one. Ashes stood out, and his ability was very difficult to deal with. He fought all over the world, and the war stimulated his potential. After reaching Grade A, the strength of his Esper Ability increased by leaps and bounds, and he became Dark-star's strongest combatant.

Tens of millions of Godora players had died in his hands, and his famous speech was the most popular speech of the Dark-star players in that version.

"I am destined to become Godora's nightmare. I will use slaughter to make them reflect on their backward traditions that have lasted for countless years. The bloodline theory that they insist on goes against the laws of reproduction and nature. It is this twisted ideology that created us, and after they repent, they will swallow the bitter fruit of the pureblood theory that has been brewing for thousands of years. Dark-star will rebuild Godora from their ashes! When that time comes, there will no longer be pure-bloods, and no one will be superior because of their bloodline. Discrimination will no longer exist, and no one will be born inferior! Half-bloods are tolerance, progress, and equality. We will eradicate the corruption. May life and hope bless Godora. "

Of course, although this speech sounded very cool and epic, Dark-star claimed to be revolutionaries. They believed that revolution required sacrifice and unscrupulous means. Other races such as Sunil suffered greatly from this. In the eyes of the lawful faction, no matter how loud Dark-star's slogan was, it was still a chaotic and evil terrorist organization.

Ironically, Ashes was not a half-blooded Godora; he belonged to another race. He had been trained by Dark-star since he was young, and this hatred had nothing to do with him. From this, it could be seen that Dark-star's mental and spiritual construction was very impressive.

Ashes was still in the secret training stage and had not reached the height of his peak. Han Xiao was the first outsider to know about Ashes' identity. At the same time, he was confused. Dark-star's actions had always been very purposeful, and everything was focused on dealing with Godora. Why would they target the Silvers?

"Dark-star wants to use this group of Silvers to threaten Silver Lingming? Impossible, this is just a group of tourists. They don't have that much power. Even if they captured the entire Silver Council, they won't be able to threaten Silver Lingming. What is Dark-star trying to do? "

Han Xiao's eyes flickered. "Could it be … these Silvers have other secrets!"

A spaceship appeared in front of them. The hatch opened, and Han Xiao flew in. Herlous greeted him and said, "They have no intention of fighting back. They don't have a fixed route, so we don't know where their destination is."

"Continue chasing."

Herlous nodded. He then saw Aroshia beside him and was stunned. He asked with surprise, "You are?"

"Don't ask. I'll explain to you next time." Han Xiao did not have time to deal with Aroshia. Through the porthole, he stared at Ashes and the others on the ground.

…

"We can't get rid of this spaceship. The other guards are on their way. We'd better leave as soon as possible," his subordinate said anxiously.

Ashes's face was solemn. The spaceship that was tailing them did not fire for a long time, which made him feel pressured.

The plan was originally perfect. The culprit that caused the current situation was the witness who suddenly appeared. It would have been fine if he could kill the witness instantly, but that witness was not only a grade B Super, but he was also immune to his Carbon Atom Deconstruction. Unbelievable! When he used this move against targets weaker than him, it had never failed!

Ames' weak organization was a fact that everyone in the Shattered Star Ring knew. However, no matter how thin a camel was, it was still bigger than a horse. The Dragon Emperor did indeed have powerful people under her command.

The survival of the witness messed up all the plans. The other party was definitely a member of Floating Dragon's organization, which was why he was able to call the guards. Ashes was helpless. He could only say that luck was not on his side.

Luckily, he found other criminals to work with. With those brutes attracting the firepower, Floating Dragon would not know that they were Dark-star.

There was no way he could wait until it was safe to interrogate the Silvers alone. Ashes gave a signal, and the members of the Special Task Force directly exchanged signals with the Silvers while they were escaping. This would increase the risk of being exposed, but he could not care less.

However, an accident happened.

All the Silvers were confused. None of them matched the secret signal.

There was no carrier in this group!
